Trump said he called off major attacks he had planned to carry out against Iran on Friday at the request of what he called "the three primary groups"—Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Qatar—who urged him to hold off and pursue a deal instead. 
Trump said he asked Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman during a phone call on Saturday whether he preferred an attack or a deal, and the Crown Prince said he would "much prefer a deal." Trump described the planned attack as "the biggest attack since the Second World War" that would have been "disastrous" for Iran.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Ten mountaineers, including world-renowned climber Nirmal "Nims" Purja, have died after an avalanche struck Broad Peak in northern Pakistan.

The avalanche hit between Camp 2 and Camp 3 at an altitude of approximately 6,600 metres, sweeping the climbing team down the mountain. Despite extensive search and rescue operations by the Pakistani military, Purja's company, Elite Expeditions, confirmed that all members of the team lost their lives.

Nims Purja was internationally celebrated for completing all 14 of the world's 8,000-metre peaks in record time and for championing the achievements of Sherpa climbers in high-altitude mountaineering.

This report examines what happened on Broad Peak, the rescue efforts, and the legacy of one of the world's most accomplished climbers.
